name: Drug Harmonizer Explorer
notes: Substance-level identities are merged as connected components over trusted source identifiers and xrefs, with PubChem, ChEMBL, ChEBI, GSRS, RxNorm, UniChem, and DrugCentral used as the source-standard priority order.
The local source-standard ID is retained as source_standard_primary_id; primary_id is the NodeNorm-preferred CURIE when NodeNorm resolves the component.
InChIKey is used as a structural identity bridge. CAS is retained as provenance/xref evidence but is not used by default as a merge key.
RxNorm clinical-drug products are exported as context edges and are not treated as exact substance identity.
Inxight Activity targets are exported as pharmacology relationship context; DDI/victim/perpetrator/tox annotations should stay in separate safety/ADME layers.
PubChem enrichment is bounded to observed source CIDs, not a full PubChem mirror; UniChem is disabled until mapping-file ingestion is implemented.
